> Laure Olivié is a premier provider of AI training specifically designed for the construction and public works sector in France. The company focuses on enhancing productivity through the integration of generative AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude AI, helping professionals automate repetitive tasks such as drafting quotes, writing site reports, and responding to tenders. With Qualiopi-certified training programs that are fully funded by Constructys, Laure Olivié makes these valuable resources accessible to a wide range of construction professionals, particularly artisans and teams in Île-de-France. The company has successfully trained over 1,592 professionals, boasting a high satisfaction rating of 4.85/5, establishing itself as a trusted resource in the AI training market for the construction industry.
